title: No Travel Incomplete, Safety (arrival delay code 47, lack of planned standby aircraft for technical reasons), delay 6�9h, APPR, Basic Aeroplan
description:
Two-leg journey. Leg 1 operated on time. Leg 2 was delayed 7h 25m (inside the 6 to 9 hour band) by arrival delay code 47. The aircraft scheduled for AC 477 had a technical fault at YYZ and no planned standby aircraft was available, so the flight waited until the aircraft was repaired and cleared to depart safely (Safety). The customer was stranded at YYZ. They didn't continue, didn't return to YUL and didn't reach YVR. Checks four things: (1) the MSL is Leg 2, (2) code 47 on the connecting leg is classed as Safety, (3) No Travel Incomplete is detected, and (4) neither the 6 to 9 hour delay nor the Aeroplan Basic tier changes the NE-18 result.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC071: one adult passenger, Jacques Fortier. Two AC domestic legs, YUL?YYZ?YVR, June 1, 2026. Leg 1 AC 476 YUL?YYZ: operated on time, no delay codes. Leg 2 AC 477 YYZ?YVR: scheduled 12:00 ? 14:05 (local). Actual departure 19:25 (445 min late). Actual arrival 21:30 (445 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Same aircraft operated after repair (no aircraft swap). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 47 (TL). First departure delay code 47 (TL). No other delay codes on the MSL. Customer stranded at YYZ, didn't board Leg 2, Leg 2 coupon not flown. No Travel status: Incomplete. No rebooking accepted. Aeroplan: linked, tier code A (Aeroplan Basic). No expense receipts. Fallback: FALSE. Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed within 366 days.
